messages:
Alex: heads-up for evening handoff — we had a series of cache-eviction spikes between 20:15-20:40 UTC that generated multiple 502/503s for some multimodel routes. paging ramped, customer impact limited to a subset of requests to /v1/generate (mostly long-context chat sessions).

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0427 — KV cache eviction storm. pages sent to @oncall at 20:18 UTC.

Maya: tl;dr — root cause looks like a mis-sized hotset after an A/B rollout; new model shards increased active KV entries and pushed a few hosts past the eviction threshold. not a network issue.

Jon: saw the 502s in the trace — backend responded with 503 when cache miss storm caused cpu + i/o spikes on bc-rt-12. I pulled the runbook (cache-eviction-storm) and started a soft-rollback to previous shard allocation around 20:25.

Alex: confirmed rollback started 20:26, autoscaler suppressed burst scale-ups to avoid noisy co-tenancy. put temporary routing rule to route heavy long-context sessions to dedicated pool (dedicated-long-ctx) at 20:28 — that cut the error rate by ~70%. :thumbsup:

Emily: added a couple firewall/logging notes — customers who saw errors: three high-traffic tenants (redwood-labs, acme-ai, noteflow). notified SEs. Emily -> please add short blurb to status page?

Emily: on it. drafting now. will push update with timeline and mitigation in 10m.

Tariq: coverage gap: next shift (overnight APAC) there is no infra-backend primary on call — only app-level coverage. need to escalate to rotation to ensure infra is primary for the overnight window. we had manual steps that required host restarts and eBPF profiling that infra folks own.

Maya: agreed. action item: swap infra primary for 23:00-07:00 UTC. Alex — can you confirm who will take primary?

Alex: pinging @Jon to be primary for 23:00-07:00 UTC? Jon, you good to take infra primary and lead the handoff to APAC oncall?

Jon: I can take it. will be primary 23:00-07:00 UTC. Emily will be secondary for app-level questions.

Maya: thanks. recording action: infra primary = Jon; app secondary = Emily. coverage gap closed.

sre-bot: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cache-eviction-storm — follow step 2 (soft rollback) then 4 (routing diversion) if soft rollback not enough.

Alex: current status at 20:45 UTC — error rate back to baseline, KV eviction tail is decaying, rollback completed 20:35. ongoing: monitoring + level set for autoscaler thresholds to prevent re-trigger.

Jon: left command snippets used for rollback if helpful:
```
# drain nodes running new shard variant
kubectl label nodes node-abc shard=old --overwrite
# route heavy-session traffic to dedicated pool
redwood-router update-route /v1/generate --pool dedicated-long-ctx --match "context>8k"
```

Maya: follow-ups for tomorrow:
- validate autoscaler hysteresis in staging (Maya)
- add a canary check to detect hotset growth before rollout (Research)
- update runbook with the exact routing command and a checklist for SE notifications (Emily)

Emily: noted. I'll add SE notification checklist: message template, affected customer list, and escalation matrix.

Tariq: customer impact assessment: estimated 0.6% of total requests across region affected during window, peak 2.3% for some tenants. commercial impact minimized due to quick rollback, but recommend proactive reach-out to top 3 affected tenants in morning (SE owned).

Alex: next steps for oncall handoff: Jon will do a brief bridge with the APAC oncall at 22:50 UTC to walk through the mitigation and the runbook. leave a pinned note in the APAC handoff channel.

Jon: will run the 22:50 walk-through and pin notes. also will check host heatmaps and eviction counters hourly until 03:00 UTC.

Maya: any other blockers for handoff?

Alex: none from infra side. thanks all — recording this thread in the incident tracker and marking INC-2026-0427 as mitigated (post-mitigation monitoring). :white_check_mark:

sre-bot: INC-2026-0427 status changed to mitigated at 20:49 UTC.

Emily: will follow up with status page and SE outreach in the morning. adding action items to the morning triage.

Jon: signing off for now, will be back at 22:45 for bridge handoff.

Alex: handoff complete for evening. primary/secondary: Jon/Emily. next check-in 22:50 UTC. thanks all. :raised_hands:
